messages:
kevin_customer: Hi — customer reports console shows a 50 USD credit labeled 'manual refund' in their org banner, but their API billing is still charging them. Can someone help triage?

olivia_support: Thanks Kevin. Do you have the org_id / project_id / service_key from the customer? Also any screenshots of the console banner?

kevin_customer: org_id=org_9XJ2, project_id=proj_7aB3, service_key=skey_live_abc123. Screenshot sent to ticket #4872 (console shows: "Credits: $50 (manual refund)"). Customer says API responses include meter_events showing charges and invoice shows $0 credits applied.

olivia_support: Reproduced on our side with their service_key: calling usage endpoint returns meter rows but no credit_application. Example: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer skey_live_abc123" \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?project=proj_7aB3
// response snippet
{
  "total_tokens": 12450,
  "billable_amount": 12.45,
  "credits_applied": 0,
  "line_items": [ ... ]
}
```

maria_billing: FYI deploy-bot shows last billing-sync job succeeded 2025-11-12T02:01:12Z. Could be a late propagation or a per-project mapping bug. Can you paste the account credits lookup?

olivia_support: Ran internal credits lookup for org_9XJ2: 
```
GET /internal/billing/accounts/org_9XJ2/credits
// returns
{
  "pending_credits": 50.00,
  "source": "manual_refund",
  "status": "active",
  "appliable_to": ["proj_7aB3"]
}
```

kevin_customer: The customer says they saw the credit banner yesterday evening, then made a few API calls this morning and got billed. They provided a sample request that shows X-Request-Id header: rq_2025_11_12_17:24:32 and correlation-id c-id-9f2b.

tim_engineer: Quick triage ideas: 1) Check if the credit record created after the usage window — if timestamps align the usage may have been charged before credit grant. 2) Confirm service_key mapping to project is identical in billing table vs console mapping. 3) Check for any bug where 'pending_credits' flag is true but credits not yet 'applied' at invoice time.

olivia_support: I compared timestamps: credit created 2025-11-12T03:10:02Z, customer calls at 2025-11-12T02:20:00Z — so usage preceded credit. But customer insists they saw the banner before making calls. Could be clock skew or UI cache.

maria_billing: I pulled audit trail: manual refund action by ops_user@maria on 2025-11-12T03:09:58Z (server time). If their browser cached a stale UI that showed a pre-approved draft credit, that could explain the mismatch. However, we should also verify retroactive credit application rules: our system only auto-applies credits to future invoices unless user checks 'apply retroactively'. Do we have that set for this refund?

olivia_support: The refund record: 
```
UPDATE credits SET amount=50, status='active', apply_retro=true WHERE id='cred_4xY'
```
It says apply_retro=true. So it should have been backfilled. Yet invoice shows no credits.

deploy-bot: billing-sync job completed at 2025-11-12T04:00:12Z; job id job_8845; changed 1 mapping for org_9XJ2.

tim_engineer: Okay next steps — can billing ops run the resync command for that org to ensure backfill executed and reprocess the invoice? Command: 
```
/bin/billing-resync --org org_9XJ2 --force --dry-run=false
```

maria_billing: I'm running resync now on staging, then prod. I'll attach correlation ids once it finishes. If resync finds no invoice changes, we'll need to run reprocess-invoice for invoice_id inv_20251112_721.

olivia_support: Sent update to customer: "We've identified the likely cause and are running a re-sync and possible invoice reprocess. We'll update in this thread once billing ops confirms." :thumbsup:

kevin_customer: Thanks — customer is asking for ETA. Can we give a timeline?

maria_billing: ETA: running resync now, should complete within 20–30 minutes; reprocess invoice is another 10–15 minutes. Will post success/failure and final invoice adjustment details here. Correlation id for resync job: rsync_1945679123.

olivia_support: Noted, I'll keep customer updated. If ops needs any DB extracts or logs, ping me and I'll attach ticket assets.

maria_billing: Resync completed: rsync_1945679123 SUCCESS. It reported 1 invoice updated (inv_20251112_721): credits_applied changed from 0 -> 50. New invoice balance -37.55 -> -87.55. Reprocess job id rp_90012 started.

deploy-bot: reprocess job rp_90012 finished SUCCESS at 2025-11-12T04:22:10Z. Billing ledger updated, customer balance adjusted.

olivia_support: Confirmed with customer — they now see credits applied and their account balance reduced. Closing once customer acknowledges.

kevin_customer: Customer confirmed the charges were refunded and visible in API now. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
